items.title: Security: COMMAND_INJECTION in commands.py:974 (subprocess shell=True)
items.desc:
**Vulnerability:** COMMAND_INJECTION
**File:** aider/commands.py:974
**Severity:** Critical

**Vulnerable code:**
subprocess.run("git " + args, shell=True)

**Why it's dangerous:**
User-controlled git args passed to shell=True
→ /git status; cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa possible
→ SSH key theft

**Fix:**
subprocess.run(["git"] + args.split(), shell=False)

**How I found it:**
pip install aina-scan
aina-vibeguard scan .

Found in 3 seconds.
Happy to submit a PR.

items.title: AI agent has more production access than your senior engineers
items.desc:
There’s a pattern I keep seeing across teams adopting AI agents for infrastructure, and it’s starting to scare me.

A team sets up an agent to help with Terraform, Kubernetes configs, or cloud deployments. To make it useful, they give it cloud credentials, state files, sometimes CI/CD pipeline access. They test it in staging. It works. They move it to production. Nobody asks: what’s the blast radius if this thing gets prompt-injected?

items.llm_title: AI代理生产权限过大面临提示注入
items.llm_summary: 团队在采用AI代理时赋予其云凭据和CI/CD访问权限，但未评估提示注入后的爆炸半径。若代理被恶意指令注入，可能导致生产环境被未经授权操作或数据泄露。

items.title: Show HN: Pincer-MCP – Stop AI agents from reading their own credentials
items.desc:
I run AI agents for coding (OpenClaw, Claude Desktop) and realized they could read their own .env files. Tested it - asked my agent to "check configuration" and it printed everything.

The problem: agents need file access to work, but if they can read files, they can read their own credentials. One prompt injection and your API keys are leaked.

items.llm_summary: AI代理因需要文件访问权限，可以读取包含API密钥的.env文件。一次提示注入攻击即可导致凭据泄露，传统环境变量和密钥管理方案无法有效防护。

items.title: AI coding tools have broad filesystem and network access
items.desc:

items.llm_summary: 该安全扫描器发现 ClawHub 上的 OpenClaw 技能定义中存在多种隐藏内容，包括 HTML 注释、零宽 Unicode 字符、CSS 隐藏文本和双向文本覆盖。这些内容在 Markdown 阅读时不可见，但会被 LLM 处理，可用于恶意提示注入，操纵代理行为。

items.llm_title: MCP 服务器普遍存在严重漏洞
items.llm_summary: 对 306 个 MCP 服务器的扫描发现，10.5% 存在至少一个严重漏洞，包括 eval() 执行不可信输入、SQL 注入和硬编码 API 凭据。由于 AI 代理信任 MCP 服务器并以其权限运行，这些漏洞可能被提示注入利用，导致代理执行恶意操作或泄露数据。
